g.text: Handset unmodified; board sits in the 4-core cable

g.desc: Handset unmodified; board sits in the 4-core cable

g.text: No combination of relay states can short the supply; there is no shoot-through failure mode.

g.desc: No combination of relay states can short the supply; there is no shoot-through failure mode.

g.text: U5 sits after the transfer relay, in the motor leg proper, so it reads current in BOTH modes.

g.desc: U5 sits after the transfer relay, in the motor leg proper, so it reads current in BOTH modes.

g.text: SEQUENCING: relays change state only with Q1 off and current decayed. On a watchdog trip Q1 turns off

g.desc: SEQUENCING: relays change state only with Q1 off and current decayed. On a watchdog trip Q1 turns off

g.text: in microseconds while relays take milliseconds to release, so contacts are cold-switched even in a fault.

g.desc: in microseconds while relays take milliseconds to release, so contacts are cold-switched even in a fault.

g.text: This board cuts into the 4-core cable between handset and motor housing; unplug it and rejoin the cable

g.desc: This board cuts into the 4-core cable between handset and motor housing; unplug it and rejoin the cable

g.text: Power loss or a watchdog timeout drops the transfer and hands the desk back to the rockers.

g.desc: Power loss or a watchdog timeout drops the transfer and hands the desk back to the rockers.

g.text: de-energised -> handset sees VSW and drives the winding (STOCK BEHAVIOUR)

g.desc: de-energised -> handset sees VSW and drives the winding (STOCK BEHAVIOUR)

g.text: K3 / K4 / K5 share one coil node and act as a 3-pole transfer:

g.desc: K3 / K4 / K5 share one coil node and act as a 3-pole transfer:

g.text: IN-LINE INTERCEPTOR. The handset keeps its factory wiring and still switches motor current in OEM mode.

g.desc: IN-LINE INTERCEPTOR. The handset keeps its factory wiring and still switches motor current in OEM mode.

g.text: to return the desk to stock.

g.desc: to return the desk to stock.

g.text: K1 / K2 give brake at rest exactly as the OEM rockers do. Both off -> both winding ends on VSW.

g.desc: K1 / K2 give brake at rest exactly as the OEM rockers do. Both off -> both winding ends on VSW.

g.text: ROCKER SENSE (dry contacts in board mode)

g.desc: ROCKER SENSE (dry contacts in board mode)

g.text: energised -> handset sees +3V3 and is isolated from the winding

g.desc: energised -> handset sees +3V3 and is isolated from the winding

g.text: hold drive lines safe before boot

g.desc: hold drive lines safe before boot

g.text: R1/R2/R6/R12 must sit on non-strapping GPIOs. ISENSE must be on ADC1 (ADC2 is unusable with WiFi).

g.desc: R1/R2/R6/R12 must sit on non-strapping GPIOs. ISENSE must be on ADC1 (ADC2 is unusable with WiFi).

g.text: K3 / K4 carry full motor current in OEM mode - rate them for the load.

g.desc: K3 / K4 carry full motor current in OEM mode - rate them for the load.
